features.scope: Все 83 OpenShell RPC, errors, auth, pagination, streaming
features.acceptance: Каждый метод имеет positive/negative/permission/cancel fixture

features.scope: 12 RPC, включая workspace storage и authentication
features.acceptance: Один и тот же contract suite для builtin/remote

features.scope: 5 RPC, backend storage, refresh/revoke
features.acceptance: Secret lifecycle без утечки материалов refresh

features.scope: 4 RPC SupervisorMiddleware + 1 response service
features.acceptance: HTTP/WS ordering, cancellation, failure semantics

features.scope: 3 RPC GatewayInterceptor
features.acceptance: Authenticated transformation и повторная проверка результата

features.scope: Exchange/Mediate, framing, identity, FD/network operations
features.acceptance: Authenticated boundary, replay/size/loss tests

features.scope: local/remote bootstrap, config, health/readiness, TLS, OIDC, operator auth
features.acceptance: Чистый deploy, restart и корректная конфигурация

features.scope: create/start/stop/delete, recovery, desired/observed state
features.acceptance: Повторные запросы и crash points не создают дубликаты

features.scope: exit finalization, restart policy, foreground attach
features.acceptance: Один terminal result на generation, restart semantics

features.scope: exec/PTY, resize, signals, stdin EOF, stdout/stderr, SSH/relay
features.acceptance: Интерактивные и non-TTY сценарии всех backend

features.scope: membership, RBAC, quota, templates, service routing/forward
features.acceptance: Scope нельзя изменить ссылкой на чужую сущность

features.scope: defaults, null/presence, validation, matching, composition
features.acceptance: Corpus совпадает с upstream по входам и результатам

features.scope: global/sandbox, versions, ACK, draft/approve/edit/undo/history
features.acceptance: Активная policy подтверждена runtime generation

features.scope: read/write/exec grants, workdir, identities, Landlock
features.acceptance: Kernel-enforced ограничения и capability evidence

features.scope: socket mediation, bypass denial, DNS/IPv4/IPv6/UDS
features.acceptance: Raw socket/direct-connect probes не обходят policy

features.scope: HTTP, TLS, TCP, WebSocket, JSON-RPC, MCP, GraphQL, SQL semantics
features.acceptance: Allow/deny/limits/protocol error fixtures

features.scope: endpoint binding, stable placeholders, refresh, managed files
features.acceptance: Secret доступен только нужной операции/endpoint

features.scope: OAuth grants and SPIFFE/subject identity, cache/expiry
features.acceptance: Binding к workspace/sandbox/provider/revision

features.scope: Profiles, inheritance, label filtering, discovery, builtins
features.acceptance: Всё содержимое upstream providers/ покрыто fixtures

features.scope: Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, VM, Windows MXC
features.acceptance: Отдельный живой lane для каждого поддержанного профиля

features.scope: Resource requests, CDI, passthrough/VFIO где применимо
features.acceptance: Реальная выдача/освобождение устройства, resource errors

features.scope: Database, Kubernetes Secrets, Vault-compatible
features.acceptance: Durable CRUD, auth, rotation и outage

features.scope: PeerRelay/readiness/endpoint/provider status
features.acceptance: Identity/fencing, reconnect и gateway outage

features.scope: Policy containment, risk queries, counterexample, coverage, timeout
features.acceptance: Within/Exceeds/Unsupported/Inconclusive без ложного allow

features.scope: OCSF, logs, events, traces, metrics, redaction
features.acceptance: Consistent schema и доказанный bounded buffering

features.scope: Всё дерево upstream команд, flags, output/exit codes, dashboard
features.acceptance: Сценарии и help inventory, PTY/golden tests

features.scope: Go API; Python/TS пользовательские поверхности
features.acceptance: Сценарии against real Go gateway, независимая установка

features.scope: Images, Helm, binaries, supported packages/install/uninstall
features.acceptance: Reproducible artifact, signature, SBOM, clean install

features.scope: Public skills/examples, troubleshooting, EN/RU guides
features.acceptance: Каждый пример работает с новым продуктом

details.title: RFC 0003 - Gateway Configuration File
headings: Compute driver — exactly one driver may be active. When omitted, the gateway
auto-detects a driver (kubernetes → podman → docker). VM is never auto-detected.
Note: database_url is a secret and must be supplied via OPENSHELL_DB_URL
(or --db-url) — it is NOT permitted in the file.
Service routing — wildcard DNS SANs in `server_sans` also enable sandbox
service URLs under that domain. `enable_loopback_service_http` toggles
plaintext HTTP routing for loopback service URLs.
TLS / mTLS — package-managed local TLS may supply listener defaults.
Mirrors --disable-tls / OPENSHELL_DISABLE_TLS. Set true explicitly for a
plaintext listener; guest TLS fields must then be omitted.
Gateway-owned CA injected into the selected local driver for supervisor TLS.
OIDC — when omitted, JWT bearer auth is disabled
Compute drivers — each table is owned and parsed by its driver crate.
Only the selected or auto-detected driver's table is activated.

files.title: RFC 0003 - Gateway Configuration File
headings: Compute driver — exactly one driver may be active. When omitted, the gateway
auto-detects a driver (kubernetes → podman → docker). VM is never auto-detected.
Note: database_url is a secret and must be supplied via OPENSHELL_DB_URL
(or --db-url) — it is NOT permitted in the file.
Service routing — wildcard DNS SANs in `server_sans` also enable sandbox
service URLs under that domain. `enable_loopback_service_http` toggles
plaintext HTTP routing for loopback service URLs.
TLS / mTLS — package-managed local TLS may supply listener defaults.
Mirrors --disable-tls / OPENSHELL_DISABLE_TLS. Set true explicitly for a
plaintext listener; guest TLS fields must then be omitted.
Gateway-owned CA injected into the selected local driver for supervisor TLS.
OIDC — when omitted, JWT bearer auth is disabled
Compute drivers — each table is owned and parsed by its driver crate.
Only the selected or auto-detected driver's table is activated.

ABI 3 or newer, introduced in Linux 6.2, with Landlock enabled. The mandatory baseline protects private channel and bootstrap files, including against truncation. A filesystem policy's `best_effort` setting never disables this baseline.

Nested user-notification filters and atomic `SECCOMP_IOCTL_NOTIF_ADDFD` with `SECCOMP_ADDFD_FLAG_SEND`, usable under the runtime's existing seccomp profile without added capabilities. The sandbox actively probes these operations before admitting the workload.

The non-dumpable broker must be able to read a same-UID, dumpable workload child's memory through `process_vm_readv` or `/proc/<pid>/mem`. The broker never writes workload memory. The sandbox actively probes the production parent-to-child topology before admitting the workload.

The sandbox binds every workload TCP and UDP socket to the loopback interface with `SO_BINDTODEVICE`, without added capabilities. Accepted sockets inherit the binding, so workloads accept connections only from inside the sandbox network namespace. The sandbox probes this before admitting the workload.
